Modified material
-----------------

The Noqui source inventory contains these eight GPL-3.0-licensed static backwear
adaptations and their corresponding original upstream Minecraft item models:

  back_bagpipe             <- bagpipe_hand.json
  back_didgeridoo          <- didgeridoo_hand.json
  back_handpan             <- handpan_hand.json
  back_lute                <- lute_hand.json
  back_portable_keyboard   <- piano_hand.json
  back_tiny_drum           <- tiny_drum_hand.json
  back_trumpet             <- trumpet_hand.json
  back_vielle              <- vielle_hand.json

The original upstream models are retained under
vendor/cosmetics/backs_immersive_melodies/models/ with their filenames. Per-item
attribution files are retained under the same source's support directory. The
upstream README and the complete GPL-3.0 license text are also included in the
source inventory and provenance records.

Changes made for Noqui
----------------------

The selected static native cuboids were extracted from the pinned upstream
models. The models were recentered on [8,8,8], uniformly scaled to backwear
proportions, and given fixed ItemDisplay transforms. Texture resource names
were remapped to the Noqui catalog, while original per-face UVs and face
rotations were retained. PNG image bytes were copied without regenerating the
artwork. The adapted outputs contain no Immersive Melodies sounds, playback
code, or melodies. The upstream GPL-3.0 grant for models and textures does not
extend to those excluded materials.

Reproduction and redistribution
-------------------------------

The reproducible conversion source is distributed as
vendor/cosmetics/backs_immersive_melodies/support/normalize_assets.py. The
original upstream models, textures, README, license, this modification notice,
and the script travel with the adapted assets in the Noqui source inventory.
The pack also includes the full GPL-3.0 text at
pack/licenses/backs_immersive_melodies.txt. These backwear adaptations and
their modified files remain available under GPL-3.0; preserve the license,
source materials, notices, and modification record when redistributing them.
